blocks.orig: Near the archipelago of Mafia, you can witness the seasonal migration of humpback whales as they move between the warm waters of the Indian Ocean and the cooler feeding grounds closer to South Africa. Step on a traditional dhow to go spot these giants of the ocean. Once the whales are in sight the boat is strategically placed and the engine shut off, so you can hopefully watch them breach, throw themselves out of the water and land with a tremendous splash. An amazing experience!
blocks.html: Close to the Mafia archipelago, you have the chance to see humpback whales on their seasonal migration between the warm Indian Ocean and the cooler feeding grounds nearer South Africa. You board a traditional dhow to look for these ocean giants. As soon as the whales are spotted, the crew positions the boat carefully and switches off the engine, so with luck you see them breach, launching themselves out of the water and coming down with a huge splash. A wonderful experience!
